title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist

Location: Cambridge, CB5 8 PA
Salary: Competitive, DOE
Contract: Full-time, Permanent- Monday to Friday (with participation in the weekend rota required)

About Peasgood & Skeates

Peasgood & Skeates is a long-established, family-owned independent funeral directors with a proud history of serving families and communities across Essex, Cambridgeshire, Suffolk and the surrounding areas.

We understand that losing someone you care about is one of the most difficult experiences in life. Our role is to provide families with care, compassion and professionalism at every stage, and our people are at the heart of delivering that service.

We are now looking for an experienced Receptionist to join our flagship Cambridge office.

About the Role

As our Receptionist, you will be the first person a bereaved family meets and will play a vital role in creating a warm, welcoming and supportive experience.

This is much more than a traditional reception role. You'll combine front-of-house responsibilities with a varied administrative workload, coordinating appointments, handling enquiries, supporting Funeral Directors and liaising with a range of external contacts.

You'll need genuine warmth and emotional intelligence, alongside the ability to remain calm, organised and professional when dealing with sensitive situations and competing priorities.

What You'll Be Doing
- Welcoming bereaved families, visitors and members of the public with warmth, dignity and discretion.
- Handling telephone enquiries sensitively, including initial calls following a death.
- Managing appointments, viewings and chapel of rest arrangements.
- Coordinating diaries and information between families, Funeral Directors and third parties.
- Liaising with clergy, celebrants, crematoria, cemeteries, doctors, coroners, florists and other suppliers.
- Preparing, completing and maintaining funeral paperwork and records accurately.
- Handling payments, invoices and account queries.
- Managing incoming and outgoing post, email and general correspondence.
- Ensuring reception, meeting rooms and public areas are maintained to an excellent standard.
- Providing wider administrative and branch support as required.
- Handling highly sensitive information with absolute confidentiality and in line with GDPR and company procedures.
- Supporting local community activities, events and fundraising where required.

What We're Looking For

Essential:
- Proven experience in a front-of-house or receptionist role this is mandatory.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- A warm, professional and empathetic telephone manner.
- High emotional intelligence and the ability to respond appropriately to people who may be distressed or grieving.
- Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to remain calm and composed while managing multiple priorities.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office, with the confidence to learn new systems.
- Absolute discretion, integrity and professionalism.
- A smart and professional appearance and manner.
- A flexible, helpful approach and genuine commitment to providing excellent service.

Desirable:
- Previous or current experience within the funeral industry.
- Knowledge of Cambridge and the surrounding area.
- Experience dealing with funeral-related organisations or third parties.
- Experience in another client-facing role involving sensitive or emotionally challenging situations.
- Full UK driving licence.

A Role That Makes a Difference

This is a rewarding opportunity to become an important part of a team supporting families during some of the most difficult moments of their lives. The role can be emotionally demanding, and you may occasionally come into contact with the deceased, so we ask applicants to consider this carefully.

In return, you'll join a well-established family business with a strong reputation for care, professionalism and service, where the contribution you make to families and the local community genuinely matters.

If you're an experienced receptionist who combines professionalism with compassion, discretion and genuine warmth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV and a short covering note explaining why this opportunity appeals to you.

No agencies please.

title: HR Coordinator
company: S&B Herba Foods Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: HR Coordinator

Location: Fulbourn, Cambridgeshire CB21 5 ET

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Full time, Permanent

Working Hours: Mon - Friday 9am - 5.30pm

About the Company:

S&B Herba Foods Ltd source and import rice and grains (and other raw materials) from across the globe to produce a wide range of ingredients to the specification of UK manufacturers and wholesalers. Our core purpose is to "Feed the nation and be a place where everyone can reach their full potential".

We have just been awarded the Investors In People standard and are embarking on a new era to attain Silver with our ultimate goal Platinum.

In order to do this, we need people that are willing to drive our Goals and Ambitions and continually improve and develop themselves as individuals, with our full support.

Our values are at the heart of everything we do:
- We Before I - We succeed by collaborating and supporting one another
- Proactive - We take ownership, anticipate challenges and find solutions
- Can Do - We approach every task with positivity and determination
- Hungry - We are driven to learn, improve and achieve more every day

If these values resonate with you, we would love to hear from you.

We have been trading for over 100 years and have a great heritage.

Come and join us - it's a great place to work!

About The Role:

We are looking for an enthusiastic, people-focused HR Coordinator to join our team, reporting directly to the HR Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about people, enjoys variety and wants to build a long-term career in Human Resources whilst helping to create a positive workplace culture.

As our HR Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting our people, culture and day-to-day operations. This new and varied position combines HR administration, employee engagement and front-of-house responsibilities. Although based at Cambridge, you will also be supporting our Liverpool site.

You will also contribute to our journey towards achieving Investors in People Silver accreditation, helping to shape initiatives that support employee development and engagement.

Key responsibilities include:
- HR administration: Provide comprehensive support throughout the employee lifecycle and maintain accurate, confidential employee records and documentation.
- Recruitment and onboarding: Support recruitment, onboarding and induction activities.
- Engagement and wellbeing: Coordinate employee engagement and wellbeing initiatives, including projects supporting our Investors in People Silver accreditation.
- Learning and Development Coordination: Support the delivery of the Company's learning and development strategy by coordinating training programmes and courses, maintaining training and skill matrices, tracking completion of mandatory and role-specific training, producing training reports, and promoting continuous professional development opportunities.
- Manager support: Assist managers with HR processes, handling sensitive employee information with discretion and professionalism.
- Continuous improvement: Help improve HR processes and support the HR Manager in terms of the service HR provides to the Company at both sites.
- Front-of-house: Delivering a professional front-of-house reception service, acting as the first point of contact for visitors, employees and external stakeholders. This will include the managing of meeting rooms, post and couriers.

About you:

We are looking for someone who:
- Is passionate about building a career in Human Resources
- Has a university degree in Human Resources or a related discipline, or is keen to pursue an HR degree or professional qualification, such as CIPD, whilst working
- Is highly organised and has excellent attention to detail
- Handles confidential information with integrity and discretion
- Communicates confidently and enjoys working with people at all levels
- Is friendly and professional, creating a positive first impression for visitors
- Is proactive, adaptable and able to manage a varied workload
- Is committed to living our company values every day

What We Offer:
- The opportunity to build a rewarding career in Human Resources
- A varied and rewarding role in which no two days are the same
- The opportunity to contribute to meaningful employee engagement initiatives
- A collaborative, supportive working environment shaped by our core values
- The chance to be part of our journey towards Investors in People Silver accreditation

Benefits:
- 22 days holiday (plus bank holidays) increasing each year by one day until a max of 25 days
- Pension Scheme + Life Assurance
- Income Protection
- Free onsite car parking
- Bike to Work Scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Support to pursue further professional qualifications
- Free rice (quarterly)

Please click the APPLY button and to submit your CV and Cover Letter.

Candidates with experience of: Human Resource Officer, Human Resource Administrator, HR Admin, HR Generalist, HR Officer, HR Specialist, Employee Relations Specialist, Employee Relations Advisor, Employee Relations Manager, HR Business Partner, HR Manager may also be considered for this role.

title: Sales Support Administrator
description:
Join the UK's leading independent school sportswear brand.

Schoolblazer has brought genuine innovation to the school apparel market, and our sportswear brand, Limitless, is now the number one sportswear brand in independent schools.

We're looking for an organised and customer-focused Sales Administrator to join our growing team. This is a varied role working closely with customers, our sales team, designers, warehouse and suppliers to help deliver outstanding service to our schools.

At Limitless, we believe sport should be accessible and enjoyable for everyone. Our products are designed specifically for young people, helping to build confidence, encourage participation and support active lifestyles.

As demand for the brand continues to grow, we're expanding our team to support existing customers and help drive future growth.

- Can prioritise workloads and work to deadlines.
- Is confident using Excel and Outlook.
- Has previous experience in an office-based administration or customer service role.

Full training and ongoing support will be provided, making this an excellent opportunity to join a market-leading brand and develop your career within a growing business.

Location and Working Hours

Our Head Office is in Oundle. A town half-way between Northampton and Peterborough. Hours are 9am - 5pm, Monday - Friday. This is an office-based position

25 days holiday pa, in addition to bank holidays.

Up to 15% of salary bonus opportunity

Workplace pension scheme

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Talent Acquisition Coordinator

Location: Peterborough
Reporting to: Head of HR

Hybrid: 3 days per week in office

About the Role

We're looking for an organised and proactive Talent Acquisition Coordinator to join our client's HR team and help drive recruitment activity across the firm. This is an exciting opportunity for a recruitment professional who enjoys managing multiple vacancies, partnering with hiring managers, and delivering an outstanding candidate experience.

The Role

As Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you will coordinate end-to-end recruitment campaigns, ensuring vacancies progress efficiently from approval through to appointment. You'll work closely with hiring managers, candidates and recruitment agencies, providing practical recruitment support whilst helping the firm attract and secure top talent.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing recruitment campaigns across a variety of business areas.
- Drafting engaging job adverts, job descriptions and attraction materials.
- Sourcing and attracting candidates through job boards, LinkedIn and professional networks.
- Managing candidate communications and recruitment pipelines.
- Coordinating interviews, assessments and selection activities.
- Building strong relationships with hiring managers and providing recruitment guidance.
- Managing relationships with recruitment agencies and external suppliers.
- Maintaining accurate recruitment data, records and reporting.
- Supporting onboarding and pre-employment screening processes.
- Promoting fair, inclusive and compliant recruitment practices.

About You

We're looking for someone who can bring:
- Experience managing recruitment campaigns within an in-house recruitment or talent acquisition environment.
- Proven candidate sourcing experience across multiple recruitment channels.
- Experience supporting and advising hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A proactive approach and confidence to provide practical recruitment advice.

Desirable
- Recruitment experience within professional services, legal, financial services or another regulated environment.
- Experience producing recruitment resources, guides or training materials.
- Knowledge of applicant tracking systems, recruitment technology and recruitment analytics.

Why Join Us?

You'll join a supportive HR team and play a key role in attracting talented people who contribute to the firm's continued success. This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact on recruitment outcomes, work closely with stakeholders across the business, and help shape a positive candidate experience.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you. Apply today to become part of a growing and collaborative team.

description: We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Recruitment Administrator to join our busy Resourcing Team. In this role, you will help shape our recruitment service and ensure a seamless, high-quality experience for candidates and hiring managers across the Trust. You will be expected to provide an efficient, customer-focused front-of-house and administrative recruitment service for Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. You will need to support the delivery of safe, timely and values-led recruitment by ensuring high-quality administration, excellent customer service to candidates and staff, and full compliance with pre-employment standards. Please see the attached Applicant Information Pack (combined Job Description and Person Specification) for key duties and responsibilities. As per Home Office guidelines, please be aware that, unfortunately, the Trust is unable to offer sponsorship for this particular position. Therefore, please be advised that if you are a Student visa holder, we will not be able to offer you a full time permanent contract unless you have:- applied for a Graduate visa- or you will have successfully completed your course and have applied for a Graduate visa before the anticipated start date of your employment- or the Trust has agreed that they will Sponsor you as a Skilled Worker and you will complete your studies within 3 months of the anticipated start date of employment This vacancy will close at midnight on 11th September 2026. Benefits to you At Cambridge University Hospitals, we want to do all we can to support good working days. We offer development opportunities and a wide range of benefits, including on-site leisure facilities, shopping concourse and day nurseries. Our good work programme currently includes providing reduced cost Stagecoach bus travel to and from Cambridge University Hospital site. Park and Ride bus journeys between Babraham Road and Trumpington sites are free, as is the route to and from Cambridge train station and our hospitals. We also subsidise the cost of parking on site for eligible staff. On CUH campus, hot food is available 24/7 and at a reduced cost for colleagues. Recently we launched the first of our staff pod break spaces. Located in the Deakin Centre, we have a purpose-created colleague-only caf, with free tea and coffee, a break space and private outside area for colleagues to rest, refuel and recharge. Just one of the ways we are working hard to support good working days at CUH. CUH is committed to assisting employees in achieving a good work-life balance irrespective of role or personal circumstances. Flexible arrangements may include, but are not limited to, part-time working, job-share, term-time working and flexible start and finish times. Please note if you would like to discuss the required hours of this role further, you should approach the contact given. In some cases, alternative working hours will be considered. We welcome applications from the Armed Forces.

The postholder will be required to support localities with unit wide working based at Hinchingbrooke Hospital in Huntingdon. Dynamic Health provides specialised community service across Cambridgeshire and Peterborough, for people aged 16 years and over living with or experiencing problems from muscles, nerves and joints. The postholder will need to be able to work effectively to support the team to achieve deadlines. The postholder will require a good knowledge of administration and possess strong organisational skills. The postholder will be required to be proactive about collaborating with their colleagues across the localities and the Trust to problem solve and overcome issues as they arise. The postholder will be required to work using their own initiative and work on active improvement of patient pathways and wait times within the unit. Judgement will also be required to ascertain whether the message warrants urgent action. This will also include making sure the reception area is clean and tidy to adhere to the health and safety policy as well as infection control. The Administrator will work under the supervision and support of the Admin Lead to provide administration support to the localities within DynamicHealth. Provide office administrative support to the MSK Physiotherapy Service and MSK Specialist Service. Assist in the administration of clinics including booking appointments, cancelling and re-scheduling of appointments using SystmOne, ensuring data quality at all times. Answer telephone calls from members of the public, communicate information about the service, register the patients on SystmOne and arrange booked call backs for physiotherapy assessment in a courteous and friendly manner. Complete the accurate registration and administration of referrals into SystmOne, clinical patient administration system. Assist with monitoring of waiting lists and clinics for the weeks ahead and plan to ensure capacity is used appropriately. This includes sending online booking SMSs to fill routine appointments and ensuring patients that have been contacted have the process followed for contact and discharging appropriately for all relevant areas. Administer referrals from the electronic referral system, the self-referral system and the email inbox to include: Retrieval and attachment of clinical referral information.Registering the patients and referral opening on SystmOneAdding the patients to appropriate waiting list for triage and questionnaire sending. To assist with the B2 task group and working through the tasks in date order to complete them in an efficient and timely manner. Tasks to include but not limited too routine letters, appt booking, Spec to Physio tasks, Community referrals, adding patients to the appropriate waiting list and sending emails back to patients and healthcare professionals. Maintain the Appointments for Booking waiting list and ensuring all the patients on the list are contacted and booked for an appointment in line with the process or time frame given. The post holder may be the first point of contact for patient complaints and as such would be required to be familiar with the Complaints Policy. The post holder will be expected to deal appropriately with these situations which may involve emotional and distressed patients. To support with the medicine management process for the bases, with receipt of delivery, adhering to the medicine management policy. Ensure photocopying / scanning is carried out appropriately and dealt with accordingly. Support with booking interpreter services for patients requiring a translator. Deputising for other members of the team in their absence, working across units or at other locations as required. To include providing cover for reception duties. Assist with keeping both manual and electronic management information systems up-to-date, including patient and staff information, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality and security of information at all timesIn conjunction with colleagues monitor and maintain the effectiveness of systems and processes and suggest/implement change when necessary. To understand the need to escalate issues through to the line manager to ensure problems are managed in line with policy. This includes reporting incidents through the datix system for investigation from the line manager. Support with the ordering of equipment and stock via the oracle system. Raise jobs with the estates team for any issues or concerns with the building. The post holder will be expected to prioritise their own workload independently and work to tight deadlines dealing effectively with enquiries from GPs, GP practice staff, other health professionals and patients. Communication: The post holder will be familiar with the Complaints Policy as the first point of contact for patient complaints, ensuring that these are dealt with appropriately and escalated as necessary. Liaise effectively with clinical, professional and administrative personnel including those from other disciplines, General Practitioners and associated staff. Liaising with patients, carers and the general public both directly and indirectly, in a polite and tactful manner, this may include dealing with difficult and aggressive people both face to face and on the telephone. Communicate effectively with patients including those with linguistic and cultural barriers both face to face and on the telephone including dealing with complex or sensitive information. To use information technology for communication including voicemail and email and for collecting medical data via SystmOne and the Choose and book system, reporting faults and problems with systems to the Information Technology technicians. Budgetary Responsibility: Assist with raising purchase orders, receiving deliveries and checking payments in line with policy and procedures. Observe a personal duty of care when operating equipment, moving deliveries and maintaining stock control. Requisition medical and stationery equipment as necessary to ensure availability in a timely manner and minimum stock levels maintained. People Management: Support other administrative colleagues with changes and expectations within the Service Maintaining own professional development and requirement to take part in appraisal and KSF process Support the admin leads when required with the recruitment process for shortlisting & interviewing. Clinical and Practice Governance: Observe and maintain strict confidentiality with regards to any patient/family/staff/records and information in line with the requirements of the Data Protection Act. Any data that is taken/shared as part of a phone call or transported, faxed or transferred electronically must be undertaken with regard to the Trust Information Governance and Information Security policies. The post holder must adhere to the Trust risk assessment and risk management processes The post holder must adhere to infection control policies and procedures Undertake mandatory training and any other training relevant to the role as required by East of England Community Health & Care NHS Trust. The post holder must participate in audits of working practices and patient satisfaction as required Provide patients and their families/carers with up-to-date information on standards they should expect from the team Participate in management supervision on a regular basis The post holder is required to participate in relevant emergency preparedness process for their team.

title: Administrator - Huntingdon
description: Job summary Job title: Administrator Contract: Bank Start: September 2026 until December 2026 Working Hours: Monday to Friday between 8:00am - 5:00pm. (7.5 hour shift per day) BENEFITS: Pension - 5% employer contribution based on qualified earnings. VIVUP - Supermarket & High Street Discounts & Employee Assistant Programme. Blue Light Card - Supermarket & High Street Discounts. Employee referral scheme. 28 days annual leave including Bank Holidays (pro-rata). Main duties of the job The post holder will be responsible for promoting, delivering, and facilitating various programmes directed by management as part of the School-Aged Immunisation Service assisting nurses in the schools or office. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Assist in the planning, delivery and evaluation of health promotion/education and public health school age immunisation programmes. Attend community-based vaccination sessions in both schools and local based settings. Work with the nursing team to ensure productive and safe sessions. Promote and facilitate collaborative working between the team, schools and other educational institutions and families, in the delivery of the immunisation programmes. Focus on ensuring all consent forms have been returned, guaranteeing new ideas go towards achieving local area targets. Ensure the process for storing, transporting, collecting and delivering vaccinations to site are adhered to. Assist in identifying home schooled children and those in Pupil Referral Units. Maintain databases to ensure records are kept up to date and that documents are prepared for school visits. Ensure online consent systems have been triaged and completed ahead of a vaccination session. Adhere to the Standard Operating Procedure for School Immunisation (SOPs). First point of contact for all administrative tasks. Have clear communication via face to face, by phone and email with children, parents and school staff. Responsible for maintaining the cold chain, ordering, and arranging transport of vaccinations to site. Actively and constructively contribute to team meetings. Undertake other duties commensurate with the level of this position. Comply with Company policies & procedures.
